prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: full-fidelity desktop web app direction comp, 1440x900 landscape
Primary request: Design the first viewport of Bork, a polished dog-themed short-post social app and resume project, as a working boarding-kennel run ledger and shift board. The app must visibly function as a readable social feed, not as a themed illustration.
Scene/backdrop: one continuous powder-coated deep forest-green work board with a broad weatherproof paper feed sheet clipped into it; compact utility rail on the left, generous readable main feed, narrow honest project note at right.
Subject: Bork dog social feed. Show logo/name Bork, navigation labels Feed, My kennel, Settings; a clear composer labeled “Leave a bork” with authentic short dog posts; warm dog profile portraits; timestamps and profile names. Use truthful demo copy only, no metrics or customer claims.
Style/medium: high-end product UI mockup with tactile industrial editorial craft, real semantic web controls, precise spacing, distinctly not Twitter.
Composition/framing: 1440x900 straight-on browser viewport. The composer is an active run card near the top. Newest borks stack below like ledger entries. One safety-orange rubber-stamp BORK action. Strong scale hierarchy, minimal container nesting.
Lighting/mood: soft daylight on durable working materials, warm and humane rather than clinical.
Color palette: #14231d deep green, #f3e9d2 stock, #e87534 action orange, #8eaa91 muted green, near-black ink.
Materials/textures: subtle powder-coated steel, weatherproof stock, rubber stamps, brass clips; tactile but never photorealistic scenery.
Text (verbatim where legible): “Bork”, “Leave a bork”, “BORK”, “Feed”, “My kennel”, “Settings”, “Public borks”, “Mabel”, “Found the sunny square. Claimed it.”
Constraints: desktop web interface; familiar posting and reading affordances; dog-first and self-aware; no fake traction; no bone-shaped buttons; no paw-print wallpaper; no gradients; no glassmorphism; no excessive rounded cards; no Twitter blue; no three-column Twitter clone.
Avoid: poster, photograph of a kennel, marketing landing page, illegible decorative text, dashboard metrics, novelty controls, extra features.
targetedEdit: Removed the duplicate decorative lower-right BORK stamp; retained the composer action.
